body.name: qalpha
body.def: For \(j=(C,s)\in J\), \(q_{\alpha,j}(\rho,\theta_j)\) is the unique \(q\) satisfying \(\int_{c_s}^{\infty}\phi(z)Q((q-r_j(\rho,\theta_j)z)/v_j(\rho,\theta_j))\,dz=\alpha Q(c_s)\); this is the active-stratum null quantile after conditioning on the full event \(E_{n,C}(\rho)\)
